pages.text: Health 220, Attack 4, Knockback Resistance 0.6, Movement Speed 0.25.$(br)A wild mage steeped to the marrow in the rite of overgrowth: no longer content to grow vines, it holds all the magic of the wild - and now answers only to you.
Unlike the vanilla Whisperer, it commands far more of the wild's spells and summons, and you can give it $(l:supreme/servants_skills/wild_mage_servant)extra foci$() for yet more.
If a Wild Mage Priest dies while you carry an empty soul jar, the jar takes their soul; right-click a Whisperer with that jar and the Whisperer is used as a new body to bring the priest back.
You can also right-click the Wild Mage with $(item)Bone Meal$() or a $(item)Soul Jar$() to heal it.
